performance_interpretation: Observed first views 1.051432–1.179246 seconds meet the 3 second target; maximum observed preset 1.041245 seconds meets the hard 2 second transition gate on reported 4 logical cores. All use HeadlessChrome 151 Linux with ANGLE SwiftShader, economy quality and animatedTransitions=false. Each case has one frame sample and frame_p95_ms=null, with targets_met.frame_p95=false. Desktop 20 ms / mobile 33 ms smoothness is NOT VERIFIED, not PASS. CPU/render submission and still screenshots do not establish GPU frame completion or continuous interaction speed.
identity_interpretation: All24 captured stats match their current fixture revision/model hash and mesh/triangle totals. Artifact file digests independently match fixture receipts. This is metadata/artifact consistency, not independent proof of every rendered surface or arbitrary AI quality.
roof_interpretation: Residential uses the canonical artifact roof: 8 visible roof meshes in exterior/street/interior/detail and 0 in aerial/cutaway; presentation roofPieces=0. Warehouse uses 2 assumed presentation roof pieces and 0 canonical roof meshes; the assumed roof is hidden in aerial/cutaway. The disclosure section is collapsed in these captures, so the full provenance explanation is not visible in the screenshots alone.
limitations: Screenshots capture the approved-viewer component, not the entire private-project journey: 1220x761 desktop and 369x822 mobile component images inside reported 1440x900 / 393x852 browser viewports.

Mobile overlays obscure portions of rear racks, roof/facade, selected door heads, thresholds and dock/cutaway edges. Controls wrap without visible horizontal overflow but use substantial height; render area is about 400 pixels tall.

The existing residential fixture still has an empty stairs-labelled room and upper exterior door without visible access structure; this fixture does not prove physical circulation. New stair captures are reviewed separately.
Room labels use fixture English names, and all-floor exterior labels do not identify each repeated level explicitly. Selected inspector IDs do contain the level.
Materials/furnishings/context remain simplified. No claim that the courtyard reference level of detail or photorealism has been attained.
These are deterministic synthetic approved fixtures with zero provider calls and conceptual approval, not evidence of fresh live AI output, structural adequacy, code compliance or permit readiness.
Still-image review does not re-execute keyboard/touch, revision race, context-loss or disposal assertions. Physical iPhone/mobile hardware was not available; desktop viewport emulation only.
No Step 4c material-library implementation is present or claimed. These economy captures do not validate future balanced-mode procedural materials.
